name: acme.ledger
description: A sample data plugin: a SQLite ledger the project owns, a declared write query and a small tool roster that let agents in this project read and append to it.

databases.description: Household transactions, amounts in integer cents. Write through the Household ledger tools, or with sqlite3 under the rules in .daintree/plugins/acme.ledger/AGENTS.md.

queries.name: add_transaction
queries.description: Append one transaction to this project's ledger and return the row as stored. For one payment across several categories use add_split_transaction. If the ledger does not exist yet, call list_transactions once to create it. A cancelled or timed-out call may still have stored the row: list before retrying.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a day the calendar has

amount_cents.description: Integer cents, never 0, negative for money out: 18.99 spent is -1899

category.description: A letter, then letters, digits, spaces, _ or -, at most 32; stored lower case

queries.sql: INSERT INTO transactions (date, amount_cents, category, memo, recorded_at) VALUES (:date, :amount_cents, lower(trim(:category, char(9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 32, 160, 5760, 8192, 8193, 8194, 8195, 8196, 8197, 8198, 8199, 8200, 8201, 8202, 8232, 8233, 8239, 8287, 12288, 65279))), :memo, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) RETURNING id, date, amount_cents, category, memo, recorded_at

agentMcp.name: Household ledger
agentMcp.description: Read transactions in this project's ledger database and record split payments.
